summary: {person} questions what a county transfer would do to a funding agreement with the state.
realLife: Some Milwaukee supervisors opposing the courthouse transfer said they feared a response from state lawmakers if the county redirected the money.
gates: A member cites the state agreement during a county vote.
weights: An upcoming state appropriation gives an unresolved assurance more weight.
inGame: needs: state agreement, proposed transfer and a member’s publicly stated concern.
